title: Optional portable Exit model
summary: Normative Exit<T,E> union preserving successful T values or complete Cause<E> failure semantics.

result_compatibility: Result<T,E> is unchanged and Exit<T,E> is an optional separate model
No implicit conversion between Result and Exit is normative
Arbitrary T and E are preserved and portable encoding requires explicit codecs for both

variants.semantics: Successful completion carrying exactly one T value.
Non-successful completion carrying exactly one Cause<E>; Cause Empty is valid.

invariants: The variant set is exactly Success and Failure
Success and Failure are mutually exclusive and unknown fields are forbidden
Exit.Failure(Empty) is valid and MUST NOT be rewritten as Success, rejected, or assigned an inferred error
All Cause cycle and resource limits apply transitively to Exit.Failure
codec_policy: A portable Exit codec MUST receive explicit codecs for T and E
Encoding and decoding MUST preserve the Exit tag, every codec-preserved T or E value, and complete Cause topology
A decoder MUST reject unknown tags, unknown fields, cycles, and Cause resource-limit violations
